scenarios.prompt: A three-actor stealth scenario combines authored perception, noise propagation, queued commands and ranged/melee actions. Compose the scenario without redefining the underlying perception, queue or hit rules.

criteria.identity: stealth_scenario_id/revision and actor/squad identities are explicit.
criteria.composition: Perception, stealth-info, plan-queue, movement and action systems remain authoritative owners.
criteria.determinism: Same scenario inputs and command set produce the same delegated requests independent of tactical UI/render cadence.
